item.title: Markets Lab 26 Nov 2026
item.description:
Markets Lab for Wednesday 25 November. This episode is read by a computer voice. The ASX 200 fell 0.4% today, and NDQ.AX was the weakest ETF on the list, down 2.8%. Information Technology led sector losses at 2.2%, while the US VIX rose 6.1%. **Daily ASX ETF report**
The ASX 200 fell 0.4% on the day.
VAF.AX (Vanguard Australian Fixed Interest) was the best performer on the list, rising 0.2%. NDQ.AX (Betashares Nasdaq 100) was the weakest, falling 2.8%.
Over one month, VAF.AX also led the list, with a gain of 2.3%. **AUD FX dashboard**
The Australian dollar was little changed on the day. AUD/JPY and AUD/USD each rose 0.1%. AUD/HKD was essentially flat.
Over the past month, the Australian dollar weakened against all three currencies. AUD/HKD fell 5.6%, AUD/USD fell 5.5% and AUD/JPY fell 4.5%.
